simple.summary: עֲנָב (ʻĂnâb) means Anab , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 11 21.

definitions.full: H6024. Anab עֲנָב proper name, of a location in hill-country of Judah Josh 11:21 ; 15:50 , Αναβ ( ωθ ), Ανωβ[ν] , modern ±Anab , 18 2-Janmiles southwest from Hebron, Buhl Geogr. 164 .
